function.name: pollQueue
function.description: This function processes a queue of file watch objects at specified intervals, checking a chunk of files at a time for any modifications. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

queue.description: The queue of file watch objects to be processed. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

pollingInterval.description: The interval in milliseconds at which the queue is polled. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

pollIndex.description: The starting index in the queue from which polling begins. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.

chunkSize.description: The number of files to be checked in each polling interval. This is JavaScript float type parameter in string representation.
